title: The Secret in the Night
old_p1: King Nebuchadnezzar had a dream, but when he woke up, he could not remember it. He told his wise men, “Tell me my dream!” Not one of them could.
Daniel, a prophet, asked the king for a little time. A prophet is a person Heavenly Father speaks to. Daniel hurried home and asked his three friends to pray with him.
old_p2: That night Heavenly Father showed Daniel the dream. Daniel thanked Him right away. “Wisdom and might are His,” he said. That means He knows all and is very strong.
In the dream, a stone cut out without hands grew into a mountain that filled the whole earth. It showed that Heavenly Father’s kingdom would grow and never end.
When something puzzles you, Heavenly Father knows the answer. Fold your hands tonight and feel how close He is.
p1: King Nebuchadnezzar had a dream, but he could not remember it. He told his wise men, “Tell me my dream!” No one could.
Daniel asked the king for a little time. He asked his three friends to pray with him.
That night, Heavenly Father showed Daniel the king’s dream. Daniel thanked Him. Heavenly Father knows everything, even things hidden in the dark.
p2: In the dream, a little stone was cut out without any hands. It grew into a mountain that filled the whole earth! Daniel said it was like Heavenly Father’s kingdom, which will never end.
When something is hard, you can pray like Daniel. Your family can pray with you too. Heavenly Father loves to help.
